name: program-runtime.research-attention-index
purpose: Read the explicit actionable section of a caller-authorized research attention index.
assumptions: The research supervisor maintains the actionable section and its stable IDs.
A parsed snapshot is not proof that every actual need was recorded.
invariants: Read only; no file changes, messages, decisions, or implicit approval.
Only ATTENTION.md under the explicit research root is read; symlink targets are refused.
Missing, malformed, oversized, or concurrently changed source is unknown, never an empty queue.
Output contains IDs and a digest, never question text.
